clue.text: Footballers veer left and right in middle of test

parts.note: to tack is to change course, as a sailing boat veers

indicators.note: right is placed in among the letters, so in here signals putting one piece inside another
the middle of the word test is its central pair of letters, dropping the outer ones

explanation.surface: A test of agility has players weaving left and right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of' takes ES from test, and 'in' puts R inside it to make ERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Players whose job is to win the ball from opponents by challenging them are footballers of a defensive kind.

clue.text: Material used to cover opening of the small door

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, here taken from the

parts.note: a hatch is a small door or opening, as in a serving hatch

explanation.surface: Something is fixed over the gap at the bottom of a little door.
explanation.definitionFit: Straw or reeds laid on a roof form a covering material for a cottage.

clue.text: Firing of one who's late?

parts.note: sounds like sacking a worker who turns up late, but 'the late' means the dead and firing means burning in a furnace

explanation.surface: An employer dismisses someone for bad timekeeping.
explanation.definitionFit: Burning a body after death is a firing of the deceased, the late person.

clue.text: Don't touch large quantity of yeast, for example

indicators.note: a large part of a word is all but its tail, so the final letter is cut off

parts.note: yeast is an example of leaven, an agent that makes dough rise

explanation.surface: A baker is told to keep their hands off a big batch of yeast.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something alone is to refrain from touching or disturbing it.

clue.text: Revolutionary form of carbon used in composition of tyre

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other, as a material used in a product

parts.note: a radial is a tyre built with its cords running radially
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: A new carbon compound is being worked into tyre rubber.
explanation.definitionFit: A revolutionary person favours sweeping political change, as a radical does.

clue.text: Character wearing the Spanish coat

indicators.note: the outer piece wears the inner one like clothing, wrapping round it

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
a character's name, as in a play's list of characters

explanation.surface: A figure in a play dons a Spanish coat.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamel is a glossy coating applied to metal, pottery or teeth.

clue.text: Plant growers run back and forth?

indicators.note: run is read backwards for the first part, while 'and forth' gives it forwards in another sense

parts.note: run is the word itself, read in the backward direction
a run is a series, as in a run of wins

explanation.surface: Someone runs to and fro along a path.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'run' is used twice: 'back' turns it to NUR, and 'forth' sends it on in its forward sense, a series.
explanation.definitionFit: Nurseries are businesses that raise plants for sale, so they grow plants.

clue.text: Average temperature is represented

parts.note: the mean is a kind of average

explanation.surface: A weather report shows the average temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: If a sign stands for something, it is said to have signified or represented that thing.

clue.text: Learned final part of testimony after ordering of retrial

indicators.note: the testimony letter comes after the rearranged piece
putting the letters of retrial into a new order
the final letter of the word testimony is taken

explanation.surface: A court hears the last of a witness's evidence after a retrial is ordered.
explanation.definitionFit: Literary describes scholarly, bookish learning, so a learned style is literary.

clue.text: Australian capital directed a retired embassy worker

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: to direct is to lead, past tense led
an aide is an assistant, as at an embassy

explanation.surface: An official in Australia's capital instructed a former diplomat's assistant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns LED A into ADEL. Adelaide is the capital of the state of South Australia, not of the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Adelaide is the capital city of South Australia.

clue.text: End of spear stuck into savage's flesh

indicators.note: the letter is pushed into the other word as a spear is stuck into flesh

parts.note: a savage person is a beast

indicators.note: the end of a spear is its point, and the end of the word spear is its last letter

explanation.surface: A spear tip is plunged into a wild animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Breast is a cut of meat, flesh from the chest of a bird or animal.

clue.text: One pruned wax plant with showy flowers

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: pruning cuts the end off, so the last letter goes

parts.note: the moon waxes when it grows, so wax means rise

explanation.surface: A gardener cuts back a wax plant that flowers brightly.
explanation.definitionFit: The iris is a garden flower with large, colourful blooms.

clue.text: Follow a groove

definitions.meaning: a groove or furrow cut in a surface, as for a pipe in a wall

explanation.definitionFit: Chase means both pursuing someone and a channel cut into a wall or metal.

clue.text: My minister, a reformist

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like my!
a rector is a parish priest or minister

explanation.surface: Goodness, a churchman who wants reform.
explanation.definitionFit: One who corrects things puts them right, which is what a reformer sets out to do.

clue.text: Leave out a large book needed to get through service

definitions.text: book needed to get through service

parts.note: to miss something is to leave it out
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Skipping a large volume needed to sit through a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: A missal is the book containing the prayers of the Mass.

clue.text: Snow vehicles avoid transport routes

parts.note: to skip something is to avoid it
lanes are routes for traffic, shipping or aircraft

explanation.surface: Travellers in snow steer clear of the main roads.
explanation.definitionFit: Aircraft fitted with skis instead of wheels can land on snow and ice.

clue.text: Small player on the field is curving ball

parts.note: a winger plays on the wing in football or rugby

explanation.surface: A slight footballer bends the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a swinger is a delivery that curves in the air.

clue.text: Fruit grew mostly next to reserve

indicators.note: most of the word grew, losing its last letter

parts.note: to engage a room or table is to reserve it

explanation.surface: Fruit grown mainly on land held in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A greengage is a small green variety of plum.

clue.text: One party after devotee

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a do is a party or celebration
later means afterwards

explanation.surface: Someone goes to a party later as a fan.
explanation.definitionFit: An idolater is a worshipper of idols, figuratively an ardent admirer or devotee.

clue.text: Proficient fighter passes men about town

parts.note: a dan is an expert grade in judo or karate, and a fighter holding it
to pass away is to die, so passes means dies

explanation.surface: A skilled boxer goes past some fashionable young men.
explanation.definitionFit: Dandies are fashionable men who care greatly about their clothes, typical men about town.

clue.text: A great, uplifting story

indicators.note: in a down light lifting the pieces up means reading them bottom to top

parts.note: a gas is something great fun, as in what a gas

explanation.surface: A great story that raises the spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: A saga is a long story, originally an Icelandic tale of heroes.

clue.text: Legitimate final blow a female delivered with right

parts.note: KO is a knockout, the blow that ends a boxing match
she refers to a female

explanation.surface: A boxer lands a fair finishing punch with the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Kosher means genuine and above board, informally legitimate.

clue.text: Outfit caught bird in food preparation area

parts.note: kit is a set of clothes or equipment, an outfit
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: A bird is caught and prepared for the pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen is the room where meals are cooked.

clue.text: Believes delicate kiss is lacking

parts.note: thin means slight or delicate

indicators.note: the word kiss without the letters of is

explanation.surface: Someone feels that a gentle kiss is missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Thinks here is a verb meaning holds an opinion or believes.

clue.text: Public notice fruit weighing less than expected

parts.note: a lime is a citrus fruit
something light weighs less than you would expect

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit proves underweight.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the limelight means being the focus of public attention.

clue.text: Takes note of currency at one time

definitions.meaning: to mark something is to notice or heed it
the German mark was a currency before the euro

explanation.definitionFit: Marks were Germany's money until the euro, and marking is noting or heeding.

clue.text: Introduction of a new product, not including a meal

indicators.note: the named letter is left out of the word

parts.note: a launch introduces a new product to the market

explanation.surface: A firm's product launch excludes any food.
explanation.definitionFit: Lunch is the meal eaten in the middle of the day.

clue.text: Left section of church could be falling away

parts.note: an apse is a domed recess at the east end of a church

explanation.surface: A neglected part of a church may be crumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: A lapse is a falling away from a standard, as a lapse in faith.

clue.text: Article supporting king working?

indicators.note: the article holds up the other pieces between its letters, as a seat bears its occupant

parts.note: the is the definite article
R stands for rex, Latin for king
on means operating or working

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture holds up a monarch on duty.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: a throne is the article that bears a king while he is at work.
explanation.definitionFit: A throne is the ceremonial seat a monarch sits on during state duties.

clue.text: Chat briefly with ordinary man of the cloth

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter of chat is dropped

parts.note: plain means ordinary or simple

explanation.surface: A quick word with a plain-speaking clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaplain is a clergyman attached to a chapel, school or regiment.

clue.text: Collection in bookstores is tough to turn down

indicators.note: the letters are collected from within these words

explanation.surface: A display in bookshops is hard to refuse.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist an offer is to refuse or turn it down.

clue.text: Numbers different entries, accepting girl's first

indicators.note: the anagram takes in the other letter, accepting it inside
the letters of entries are made different, rearranged
the first letter of girl's

explanation.surface: Various entries take in a girl's figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' rearranges ENTRIES to INTERES, and 'accepting' puts the G of 'girl's first' inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Integers are whole numbers.
